description: A bare string-literal expression at the very start of a program, ahead of any other construct, is recognised as a prologue directive; consecutive leading string literals each count as directives. Once an ordinary statement has appeared, a following string literal is no longer in directive position and is parsed as an ordinary expression statement. The outcome reports the number of recognised directives separately from the top-level statement count, parsing succeeds without aborting, and no diagnostics are produced.
